ticket.title: outfeed lockfiles reports success when it discovers zero repositories
ticket.description:
Run inside a member repository, `outfeed lockfiles` finds zero repositories and prints "All 0 repositories track a fresh Cargo.lock" with exit 0. Observed 2026-11-07 in common/. A check that reports success on an empty set is the silence class this suite keeps removing: it should either scope to the suite root by discovery or say plainly that it found nothing to check.

LIVE 2026-11-07, after the second fix, run inside common/:

  outfeed: . holds no repositories; checked the suite at /Users/wolff/dev2026/neurosymbolic-suite
  REPOSITORY     LOCKFILE     FRESH
  batten         tracked      yes
  benchwork      tracked      yes
  ...

Before: "All 0 repositories track a fresh Cargo.lock", exit 0. The first fix (7af2b93) turned the empty pass into an error but the suite fallback did not fire, because resolve_repo_dir hands the core a relative dot and Path::ancestors stops at the current directory; fixed in c50df0a. Three unit tests passed while the CLI invocation path was still broken - a test cannot change the process working directory, which is why the live run was the thing that found it.

verification_receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d .
